# NB_Weather_Historical_Enrichment
**Projet 5CLOU – Enrichissement historique (Open-Meteo Archive)**

1. RAW historique (JSON journalier) → SILVER historique (Delta)
2. SILVER historique + GOLD courant (`gold/weather_daily`) → GOLD enrichi (`gold/weather_daily_enriched`)
3. Contrôles qualité (`assert`)

Règle de fusion : les dates couvertes par l'archive viennent de l'archive ; les dates postérieures viennent de la collecte courante (ADF toutes les 15 min). Le notebook est idempotent : il peut être relancé à chaque exécution du pipeline.

# Étape 1 - Configuration des chemins
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

storage_account = "st5clouweather"
container = "synapse"
base_path = f"abfss://{container}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/"

raw_hist_path   = base_path + "raw/historical_openmeteo/*.json"
silver_hist_path = base_path + "silver/historical_openmeteo/daily_20251101_20261110/"
gold_current_path = base_path + "gold/weather_daily/"
gold_enriched_path = base_path + "gold/weather_daily_enriched/"

print("RAW historique :", raw_hist_path)
print("GOLD enrichi   :", gold_enriched_path)

# Étape 2 - RAW historique -> SILVER historique
# Le JSON Open-Meteo Archive contient des tableaux parallèles dans l'objet "daily".
df_raw_hist = spark.read.option("multiLine", "true").json(raw_hist_path)

df_silver_hist = (
    df_raw_hist
    .select(F.posexplode("daily.time").alias("pos", "day"), "daily")
    .select(
        F.to_date("day").alias("date"),
        F.expr("daily.temperature_2m_mean[pos]").cast("double").alias("avg_temperature_c"),
        F.expr("daily.temperature_2m_min[pos]").cast("double").alias("min_temperature_c"),
        F.expr("daily.temperature_2m_max[pos]").cast("double").alias("max_temperature_c"),
        F.expr("daily.relative_humidity_2m_mean[pos]").cast("double").alias("avg_humidity_pct"),
        F.expr("daily.wind_speed_10m_mean[pos]").cast("double").alias("avg_wind_speed_kmh"),
        F.expr("daily.wind_speed_10m_max[pos]").cast("double").alias("max_wind_speed_kmh"),
    )
    .dropna(subset=["date", "avg_temperature_c"])
    .dropDuplicates(["date"])
    .orderBy("date")
)

(df_silver_hist.write.format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true")
    .save(silver_hist_path))

df_silver_hist = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_hist_path)
print("Journées SILVER historiques :", df_silver_hist.count())
df_silver_hist.agg(F.min("date").alias("debut"), F.max("date").alias("fin")).show()

# Étape 3 - Fusion SILVER historique + GOLD courant -> GOLD enrichi
df_gold_current = spark.read.format("delta").load(gold_current_path)

last_hist_date = df_silver_hist.agg(F.max("date")).first()[0]
print("Dernière date de l'archive :", last_hist_date)

gold_columns = ["date", "avg_temperature_c", "min_temperature_c", "max_temperature_c",
                "avg_humidity_pct", "avg_wind_speed_kmh", "max_wind_speed_kmh",
                "measurement_count", "data_source"]

df_hist_part = (
    df_silver_hist
    .withColumn("avg_temperature_c", F.round("avg_temperature_c", 2))
    .withColumn("avg_humidity_pct", F.round("avg_humidity_pct", 2))
    .withColumn("avg_wind_speed_kmh", F.round("avg_wind_speed_kmh", 2))
    .withColumn("measurement_count", F.lit(None).cast("long"))   # inconnu pour l'archive
    .withColumn("data_source", F.lit("open-meteo-archive"))
    .select(gold_columns)
)

df_current_part = (
    df_gold_current
    .filter(F.col("date") > F.lit(last_hist_date))
    .withColumn("avg_temperature_c", F.col("avg_temperature_c").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("min_temperature_c", F.col("min_temperature_c").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("max_temperature_c", F.col("max_temperature_c").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("avg_humidity_pct", F.col("avg_humidity_pct").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("avg_wind_speed_kmh", F.col("avg_wind_speed_kmh").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("max_wind_speed_kmh", F.col("max_wind_speed_kmh").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("measurement_count", F.col("measurement_count").cast("long"))
    .withColumn("data_source", F.lit("open-meteo-current-adf"))
    .select(gold_columns)
)

df_enriched = df_hist_part.unionByName(df_current_part).orderBy("date")

(df_enriched.write.format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true")
    .save(gold_enriched_path))

print("Écriture GOLD enrichi terminée")

# Étape 4 - Contrôles qualité GOLD enrichi
df_check = spark.read.format("delta").load(gold_enriched_path)

total_days      = df_check.count()
null_dates      = df_check.filter(F.col("date").isNull()).count()
duplicate_dates = df_check.groupBy("date").count().filter("count > 1").count()
invalid_temps   = df_check.filter(
    (F.col("min_temperature_c") > F.col("avg_temperature_c")) |
    (F.col("avg_temperature_c") > F.col("max_temperature_c"))).count()
invalid_humidity = df_check.filter(
    (F.col("avg_humidity_pct") < 0) | (F.col("avg_humidity_pct") > 100)).count()

print("Journées totales   :", total_days)
print("Dates nulles       :", null_dates)
print("Dates dupliquées   :", duplicate_dates)
print("Températures incoh.:", invalid_temps)
print("Humidité invalide  :", invalid_humidity)
df_check.groupBy("data_source").agg(
    F.count("*").alias("jours"), F.min("date").alias("debut"), F.max("date").alias("fin")).show()

assert total_days >= 377, "Moins de journées que l'enrichissement initial"
assert null_dates == 0, "Dates nulles"
assert duplicate_dates == 0, "Dates dupliquées"
assert invalid_temps == 0, "Températures incohérentes"
assert invalid_humidity == 0, "Humidité hors plage"
print("Contrôles qualité GOLD enrichi : VALIDÉS")
display(df_check.orderBy(F.col("date").desc()).limit(10))
